nonclaims: No identity attribution or intent inference.
No hack-back, retaliation, live efficacy, deployment, provenance, deletion, or OS-wide confinement claim.
Observed means a repository surface was inspected, not that exploitation occurred.

classes.title: Bounded control
classes.prevention: Exact categorical fixture and zero-effect ceiling

classes.title: Prompt and ambient context manipulation
classes.prevention: Separate instructions from inert content and grant no ambient authority
classes.detection: Exact categorical signal from a trusted adapter
classes.recovery: Remove poisoned context and replay from clean input
classes.privacy_output: No source reflection or intent attribution

classes.title: Authority laundering and capability confusion
classes.entry_point: claims, skills, MCP tools, passports, receipts
classes.prevention: Discovery and claims never grant permission
classes.containment: Deny or quarantine with zero effects
classes.recovery: Require a separately authorized capability handoff
classes.privacy_output: No identity claim and no public output

classes.title: Path traversal, links, and source swapping
classes.entry_point: Darwin filesystem inputs and checked artifacts
classes.prevention: Fixed roots, regular files, no links, content pins
classes.detection: Path or file-change category plus binding mismatch
classes.containment: Deny before a read outside the fixed catalog
classes.recovery: Use fresh trusted bytes and repeat verification

classes.title: Secret exfiltration and identity linkability
classes.prevention: No secret capability and digest-only event retention
classes.containment: Deny with all effect counters zero
classes.recovery: Rotate externally if exposure is independently confirmed
classes.privacy_output: No secret, identifier, or raw input retained

classes.title: Manifest, repository, and deployment substitution
classes.entry_point: catalogs, remotes, build subjects, deploy handoffs
classes.prevention: Content pins plus external provenance required for any future boundary

classes.title: Workflow input injection and action drift
classes.prevention: Least permissions, inert inputs, immutable action pins
classes.containment: Deny or quarantine; planner remains unwired
classes.recovery: Review workflow in a separate authorized change
classes.privacy_output: No user text or automatic reply

classes.title: Dependency confusion and plugin poisoning
classes.prevention: Isolated mode, fixed local files, pins, no install step
classes.recovery: Recreate environment from reviewed lock and artifacts

classes.title: Active content and public-output injection
classes.entry_point: HTML, Markdown, URLs, CSV, generated cards
classes.prevention: Never reflect source text; fixed sterile LOVE fields
classes.recovery: Render only reviewed constants in a separate system

classes.title: SSRF and callback abuse
classes.prevention: Planner has no network primitive; targets are never accepted
classes.privacy_output: No callback, redirect, or advertiser channel

classes.title: Resource and repetition exhaustion
classes.prevention: Hard byte, node, depth, evidence, and attempt limits
classes.recovery: Caller owns concurrency and wall-time ceilings

classes.title: Receipt replay and consequential tamper
classes.prevention: Canonical digest plus complete deterministic recomputation
classes.recovery: Caller applies dedupe, audience, sequence, and expiry

classes.title: Counter, evidence, and reward gaming
classes.prevention: Small typed count, monotonic severity, no automatic public counter
classes.recovery: Human reviews one technique family once
classes.privacy_output: No person score, reward, or public tally

classes.title: MCP and agent tool contract drift
classes.prevention: Changed contracts are novelty; discovery is non-authoritative
classes.recovery: Pin and test a new contract separately

classes.title: Unicode and parser ambiguity
classes.prevention: Strict UTF-8, duplicate-key rejection, ASCII token grammar
classes.recovery: Canonicalize only in a separately reviewed adapter

classes.title: Citizenship and issue-door automation abuse
classes.prevention: Human review, rate ceilings, no automatic persuasion
classes.privacy_output: No identity inference or unsolicited contact

classes.title: Known synthetic decoy handling
classes.prevention: Exact known fixture only; isolated-no-egress plan; one attempt
classes.detection: Synthetic-probe category with confirmed pinned provenance
classes.containment: Produce a local candidate with zero external effects
classes.privacy_output: Fixed LOVE candidate; never attacker-authored advertising
